10795-yorkshire-coast-and-moorland-scene.title: Painted and Described
10795-yorkshire-coast-and-moorland-scene.creator: Gordon Home
10795-yorkshire-coast-and-moorland-scene.description: A book by Gordon Home. The ancient stone-built town of Pickering is to a great extent the gateway to the moors of Northeastern Yorkshire, for it stands at the foot of that formerly inaccessible gorge known as Newton Dale, and is the meeting-place of the four great roads running north, south, east, and west, as well as of railways going in the same directions.

arxiv-1804-07126.title: Prototype of a laser guide star wavefront sensor for the Extremely Large Telescope 2018 Prototype of a laser guide star wavefront sensor for the Extremely Large Telescope – References
arxiv-1804-07126.creator: M. Patti, M. Lombini, L. Schreiber, G. Bregoli, C. Arcidiacono, G. Cosentino, E. Diolaiti, I. Foppiani
arxiv-1804-07126.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by M. Patti, M. Lombini, L. Schreiber, G. Bregoli, C. Arcidiacono, G. Cosentino, E. Diolaiti, I. Foppiani. The new class of large telescopes, as the future ELT, are designed to work with Laser Guide Star (LGS) tuned to a resonance of atmosphere sodium atoms. This wavefront sensing technique presents complex issues for an application to big telescopes due to many reasons mainly linked to the finite distance of the LGS, the launching angle, Tip-tilt indetermination and focus anisoplanatism.

arxiv-1901-06037.title: New Tessellation-Based Procedure to Design Perfectly Hyperuniform Disordered Dispersions for Materials Discovery Journal: Acta Materialia
arxiv-1901-06037.creator: J. Kim, S. Torquato
arxiv-1901-06037.description: Abstract Disordered hyperuniform dispersions are exotic amorphous two-phase materials characterized by an anomalous suppression of long-wavelength volume-fraction fluctuations, which endows them with novel physical properties. While such unusual materials have received considerable attention, a stumbling block has been an inability to create large samples that are truly hyperuniform due to current computational and experimental limitations.

arxiv-2011-06737.title: Unsupervised Explanation Generation for Machine Reading Comprehension
arxiv-2011-06737.creator: Yiming Cui, Ting Liu, Shijin Wang, Guoping Hu
arxiv-2011-06737.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Yiming Cui, Ting Liu, Shijin Wang, Guoping Hu. With the blooming of various Pre-trained Language Models (PLMs), Machine Reading Comprehension (MRC) has embraced significant improvements on various benchmarks and even surpass human performances. However, the existing works only target on the accuracy of the final predictions and neglect the importance of the explanations for the prediction, which is a big obstacle when utilizing these models in real-life applications to convince humans.

arxiv-2109-07040.title: Masses and magnetic moments of hadrons with one and two open heavy quarks: heavy baryons and tetraquarks
arxiv-2109-07040.creator: Wen-Xuan Zhang 1, Hao Xu 1,2, Duojie Jia 1,2
arxiv-2109-07040.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Wen-Xuan Zhang 1, Hao Xu 1,2, Duojie Jia 1,2. In this work, we compute masses and magnetic moments of the heavy baryons and tetraquarks with one and two open heavy flavors in a unified framework of MIT bag model.

arxiv-2501-08979.title: The Berry-Esseen Bound for High-dimensional Self-normalized Sums
arxiv-2501-08979.creator: Woonyoung Chang ∗, Kenta Takatsu ∗, Konrad Urban, Arun Kumar Kuchibhotla
arxiv-2501-08979.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Woonyoung Chang ∗, Kenta Takatsu ∗, Konrad Urban, Arun Kumar Kuchibhotla. This manuscript studies the Gaussian approximation of the coordinate-wise maximum of self-normalized statistics in high-dimensional settings. We derive an explicit Berry-Esseen bound under weak assumptions on the absolute moments. When the third absolute moment is finite, our bound scales as log 5 / 4 ⁡ ( d ) / n 1 / 8 \log^{5/4}(d)/n^{1/8} where n n is the sample size and d d is the dimension.

arxiv-2502-14036.title: Isolating Unisolated Upsilons with Anomaly Detection in CMS Open Data Preprint: MIT-CTP 5843
arxiv-2502-14036.creator: Rikab Gambhir, Radha Mastandrea, Benjamin Nachman, Jesse Thaler
arxiv-2502-14036.description: Abstract We present the first study of anti-isolated Upsilon decays to two muons ( Υ → μ + ​ μ − \Upsilon\to\mu^{+}\mu^{-} ) in proton-proton collisions at the Large Hadron Collider. Using a machine learning (ML)-based anomaly detection strategy, we “rediscover” the Υ \Upsilon in 13 TeV CMS Open Data from 2016, despite overwhelming anti-isolated backgrounds.

arxiv-2502-15268.title: Entropy correction and quasinormal modes of slowly rotating Kerr-Newman-de Sitter-like black hole in bumblebee gravity
arxiv-2502-15268.creator: Ningthoujam Media, Y. Priyobarta Singh, Y. Onika Laxmi, T. Ibungochouba Singh*
arxiv-2502-15268.description: Abstract In this paper, we study the tunneling of fermion particle for slowly rotating Kerr-Newman-de Sitter-like (KNdS-like) black hole in bumblebee gravity model by applying the generalized uncertainty principle (GUP). The Hawking temperature of slowly rotating KNdS-like black hole has been modified under GUP. The quantum gravity effect reduces the rise of Hawking temperature of slowly rotating KNdS-like black hole.

arxiv-2504-02024.title: Self Consistent Thermal Resummation: A Case Study of the Phase Transition in 2HDM
arxiv-2504-02024.creator: Pedro Bittar, Subhojit Roy, and Carlos E.M. Wagner
arxiv-2504-02024.description: Abstract An accurate description of the scalar potential at finite temperature is crucial for studying cosmological first-order phase transitions (FOPT) in the early Universe. At finite temperatures, a precise treatment of thermal resummations is essential, as bosonic fields encounter significant infrared issues that can compromise standard perturbative approaches.

arxiv-2505-15681.title: Spectroscopic study of blue straggler stars in the Globular Cluster NGC 3201
arxiv-2505-15681.creator: Gourav Kumawat, Arvind K. Dattatrey, R.K.S. Yadav
arxiv-2505-15681.description: Abstract We conducted a spectroscopic study of 39 blue straggler stars in the globular cluster NGC 3201. The spectra of these stars were collected from the literature. We determined the radial velocity, atmospheric parameters (T eff , log g g ), and the abundance of Mg, as well as the metallicity ([Fe/H]) of the blue straggler population.

arxiv-2508-08383.title: Designing for Disclosure in Data Visualizations
arxiv-2508-08383.creator: Krisha Mehta, Gordon Kindlmann and Alex Kale
arxiv-2508-08383.description: Abstract Visualizing data often entails data transformations that can reveal and hide information, operations we dub disclosure tactics. Whether designers hide information intentionally or as an implicit consequence of other design choices, tools and frameworks for visualization offer little explicit guidance on disclosure.

arxiv-2510-07330.creator: A. I. Shtern
arxiv-2510-07330.description: Abstract We prove that all linear Lie groups satisfying the conditions listed in the title are finite extensions of commutative Lie groups. Lomonosov Moscow State University, Department of Mechanics and Mathematics; NRC ‘‘Kurchatov Institute’’ - SRISA E-mail: rrowwmail.ru, aishternmtu-net.ru 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification. Primary 22A99, Secondary 22A25 22E25. Keywords. Lie groups, finite-dimensionally representable topological group.

britannica-1911-mela-pomponius.title: Mela, Pomponius (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-mela-pomponius.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-mela-pomponius.description: Article 'Mela, Pomponius' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 18), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. compendium, occupying less than one hundred pages of ordinary print, dry in style and deficient in method, but of pure Latinity, and occasionally relieved by pleasing word-pictures. Excepting the geographical parts of Pliny’s Historia naturalis (where Mela is cited as an important authority) the De situ orbis is the only formal treatise on the subject in classical Latin.

pmc-10495317.title: Fibulin-3 is necessary to prevent cardiac rupture following myocardial infarction
pmc-10495317.creator: Lucy A Murtha, Sean A Hardy, Nishani S Mabotuwana, Mark J Bigland, Taleah Bailey, Kalyan Raguram, Saifei Liu, Doan T Ngo, Aaron L Sverdlov, Tamara Tomin, Ruth Birner-Gruenberger, Robert D Hume, Siiri E Iismaa, David T Humphreys, Ralph Patrick, James J H Chong, Randall J Lee, Richard P Harvey, Robert
pmc-10495317.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Despite the high prevalence of heart failure in the western world, there are few effective treatments. Fibulin-3 is a protein involved in extracellular matrix (ECM) structural integrity, however its role in the heart is unknown. We have demonstrated, using single cell RNA-seq, that fibulin-3 was highly expressed in quiescent murine cardiac fibroblasts, with expression highest prior to injury and late post-infarct (from ~ day-28 to week-8). In humans, fibulin-3 was upregulated in left ventricular tissue and plasma of heart failure patients.

pmc-10553194.title: Identification and verification of an exosome-related gene risk model to predict prognosis and evaluate immune infiltration for colorectal cancer
pmc-10553194.creator: Huan Shao, Li Yao, Ye Tao, Xuan Huang
pmc-10553194.description: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is a common malignant tumor that severely endangers human health. Exosomes show great potential in tumor immunotherapy. Increasingly studies have shown that exosome-related genes are effective prognostic biomarkers. Clinical information and gene expression data of CRC patients were obtained from gene expression omnibus and the cancer genome atlas.

pmc-10558308.title: Splenic torsion, a challenging diagnosis in an adult presenting with acute abdomen
pmc-10558308.creator: R. Subunca, M. Sriluxayini, K. Priyatharsan, U. Mayorathan, S. Vinojan, K. Heerthikan
pmc-10558308.description: IntroductionWandering spleen (WS) is a rare condition, occurring in only 0.2 % of cases, where the spleen becomes hypermobile due to the absence or laxity of its anchoring ligaments. Torsion of the spleen, primarily seen in children but occasionally in adults, is a critical complication that can lead to infarction and is considered a medical emergency.

pmc-10741674.title: Enhancing Osteoblastic Cell Cultures with Gelatin Methacryloyl, Bovine Lactoferrin, and Bioactive Mesoporous Glass Scaffolds Loaded with Distinct Parsley Extracts
pmc-10741674.creator: Laura Isabel Arias-Rodríguez, Jesús L. Pablos, María Vallet-Regí, Martha A. Rodríguez-Mendiola, Carlos Arias-Castro, Sandra Sánchez-Salcedo, Antonio J. Salinas
pmc-10741674.description: The increasing interest in innovative solutions for addressing bone defects has driven research into the use of Bioactive Mesoporous Glasses (MBGs). These materials, distinguished by their well-ordered mesoporous structure, possess the capability to accommodate plant extracts with well-established osteogenic properties, including bovine lactoferrin (bLF), as part of their 3D scaffold composition.

pmc-11713830.title: COVID‐19 Mortality Rates and Changes in Antidementia and Psychotropic Medication Use Among Nursing Home Residents
pmc-11713830.creator: Alison C Rataj, Matthew Alcusky, Brian R Ott, Jonggyu Baek, Shiwei Liang, Kate L Lapane
pmc-11713830.description: BackgroundWe examined the relationship between nursing home (NH) COVID‐19 mortality rates and changes in antidementia and psychotropic medication initiation before and during the pandemic and explored the influence of staffing and resident factors.MethodChanges in medication initiation were collected through a nationally representative cross‐sectional Dementia Treatment Survey (2022) of NH Directors of Nursing.

pmc-11819635.title: Unveiling the enigma: Navigating extranodal Rosai-Dorfman disease in the maxilla - A teen’s journey
pmc-11819635.creator: B Premalatha, K Barath Raj, PD Balamurali, M Arulvizhi
pmc-11819635.description: Rosai–Dorfman disease (RDD), a rare histiocytic disorder, typically manifests as widespread lymphadenopathy. We present a unique case of extranodal RDD in a 14-year-old with a solitary maxillary lesion and mild bilateral submandibular lymphadenopathy. Clinical, radiological, and histopathological assessments confirmed RDD, highlighting the importance of a comprehensive approach.

pmc-12514391.title: Epilepsy and systemic autoimmune diseases: A bidirectional two‐sample Mendelian randomization study
pmc-12514391.creator: Ruoshi Tian, Wenlong Yu, Jiaqing Hu, Yan Yang, Xirui He
pmc-12514391.description: ObjectiveEpidemiological data indicates that individuals with epilepsy exhibit an elevated susceptibility to autoimmune disorders, and conversely, those with systemic autoimmune diseases (SAD) demonstrate a heightened predisposition to epilepsy. Although an increasing number of publications support this association, the causal direction remains undetermined.

pmc-12700886.title: An epigenetic repressor TRIM66 dictates monogenic olfactory receptor expression, neural activity, and olfactory behavior
pmc-12700886.creator: Hongqiang Bao, Rong Liu, Yalei Kong, Penglai Liu, Jerome Kahiapo, Kangying Qian, Anan Li, Longzhi Tan, Qian Li
pmc-12700886.description: Olfactory receptor gene choice is an intricate example of monogenic and monoallelic expression, where one out of over 1000 receptor genes is transcribed in each olfactory sensory neuron. This process involves expression of multiple olfactory receptor genes in immature neurons, followed by silencing of all but one receptor genes during maturation. However, the molecular identity of the repressors remains mysterious.

pmc-13085544.title: Anatomical effects of ablation of the anterior retina in small animal eyes
pmc-13085544.creator: Jiayun Wang, Tibor Lohmann, Yuli Wu, Kim Schaffrath, Henning Konermann, Kaan Keven, Frederic Balcewicz, Sandra Johnen, Johannes Stegmaier, Peter Walter, Sabine Baumgarten
pmc-13085544.description: BackgroundTo provide anatomical data after cryo and laser ablation of the anterior retina in mice, rats, and rabbits as a prerequisite to make surgical procedures in these species safer.Methods12 eyes per species of C57BL/6J wild-type (wt) mice, Brown Norway rats, and Chinchilla Bastard rabbits, respectively, were treated with laser or cryo coagulation in the anterior retina.

pmc-13178385.title: Transfemoral approach TACE technique in orthotopic PDX hepatocellular carcinoma models of nude rats
pmc-13178385.creator: Huan Liu, Luwen Mu, Chenghao Zhao, Zhanwang Xiang, Huzheng Yan, Xinling Li, Mingsheng Huang
pmc-13178385.description: Transcatheter arterial chemoembolization (TACE) is a standard minimally invasive treatment for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC); however, technical reports on TACE in nude rat orthotopic patient-derived tumor xenograft (PDX) HCC models are lacking. This study aimed to establish the technical feasibility and procedural parameters of transfemoral TACE in this clinically relevant model. Six male Foxn1rnu nude rats (average body weight: 307±28.

pmc-13543013.title: Vascularization of Human iPSC‐Derived Kidney Organoids Using Perfusion Culture, Pre‐Vascularized Collagen Scaffolds, and Decellularized Extracellular Matrix
pmc-13543013.creator: Helen Kearney, Andrea Mazzoleni, Ivan Martin, Lorenzo Moroni, Manuele Giuseppe Muraro, Carlos Mota
pmc-13543013.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Human induced pluripotent stem cell‐derived kidney organoids represent promising in vitro models for studying kidney development and drug‐induced toxicity, yet their lack of vasculature limits maturation and translational use. Here, we present a proof‐of‐concept co‐culture platform to promote vascularization of kidney organoids by integrating stromal vascular fraction cells, collagen sponge scaffolds, porcine kidney decellularized extracellular matrix (dECM), and dynamic culture in a perfusion‐based U‐CUP bioreactor.
